definitions.explanation: Something made to look like the genuine article in order to deceive. Can refer to counterfeit goods, forged documents, or a person pretending to be something they are not.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{偽物|にせもの}だ。
{偽物|にせもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ブランド→ブランド：05221_burando⟧⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}って→買う：00489_kau⟧しまった。
examples.english: I accidentally bought a counterfeit brand-name product.

examples.japanese: ⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{偽物|にせもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見分|みわ}け⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧つかないほど⟦{精巧|せいこう}→精巧：03775_seikou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦できている→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: It is so well made that you cannot tell the real thing from the fake.

notes:
The opposite of ⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧ (the real thing). {偽物|にせもの} carries a strongly negative connotation, implying deliberate deception or fraud.

ALTERNATIVE READING:
Sometimes read as にせもの or ぎぶつ. The reading にせもの is standard.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {偽物|にせもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つかまされる: to be passed off a fake
- {偽物|にせもの}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見抜|みぬ}く→見抜く：06975_minuku⟧: to see through a fake
- ⟦{本物|ほんもの}→本物：03628_honmono⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{偽物|にせもの}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{見分|みわ}け: distinguishing real from fake

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {偽物|にせもの}: a fake item (implies deception)
- {模造品|もぞうひん}: imitation, replica (more neutral, may be legal)
- {贋作|がんさく}: forgery (specifically art or documents)
- ⟦コピー→コピー：04883_kopii⟧⟦{品|ひん}→品：03712_hin⟧: knockoff, copy product
